fields.label: Location
fields.note: Free-text location inside the finder string; the response echoes it back as 'Location'/'LocationId'. The locationsFacet lists the wider set. Facility-level narrowing uses selectedLocationsFacet with the numeric ids from workLocationsFacet.

fields.label: Category
fields.note: categoriesFacet publishes the ids (e.g. Engineering 300000003426001); the response echoes the applied selection as SelectedCategoriesFacet.

fields.label: Workplace
fields.note: Facet ids are ORA_HYBRID, ORA_ON_SITE, ORA_REMOTE. Confirmed live: selectedWorkplaceTypesFacet=ORA_REMOTE returned 11 jobs, all WorkplaceType 'Remote'.

notes: The icertis.com careers page hands off to Oracle Candidate Experience on iaaviz.fa.ocs.oraclecloud.com (siteNumber CX_1, site short URL 'Jobs-at-Icertis'). The single search entry point is the recruitingCEJobRequisitions REST resource, driven by a finder string: findReqs;siteNumber=CX_1,facetsList=WORK_LOCATIONS;WORKPLACE_TYPES;TITLES;CATEGORIES;ORGANIZATIONS;POSTING_DATES;FLEX_FIELDS;LOCATIONS,limit=25,sortBy=POSTING_DATES_DESC,offset=N plus optional keyword=, location=, selectedWorkplaceTypesFacet=, selectedCategoriesFacet=, selectedLocationsFacet=, selectedTitlesFacet=, selectedPostingDatesFacet=. Every accepted filter is echoed back on the result block (Keyword/Location/Selected*), which is how the machine-usable set was confirmed. No job-family finder parameter was evidenced, so none is declared.
